inspection: Opening source frames around 0 through 11 seconds and spaced samples across the film were visually inspected. Audio and full continuous playback were not inspected. Sampled frame notes do not establish exact cut boundaries.
opening_sample_observations: 0s: full-body male presenter in a bright loft with large windows; no opening logo-only card.
About 1s: white sentence fragment appears over the wide presenter shot.
About 2s: close presenter shot; about 3s: sunset silhouette under palms.
About 5–7s: ordinary barbecue and moving-dog footage contrasts with the polished scene.
About 9–11s: camera operator with cinema rig and another man holding a lens create a visible filmmaking context.
whole_film_samples: Spaced frames show a man filming on a phone, close product interactions, black-and-white city imagery, an outdoor presenter, onboarding on a phone and a tennis/selfie sequence, ending in the Kino mark.
preset_demo_inspection: Representative frames about three seconds apart were inspected. They show diagonal boundaries comparing two treatments of the same photographic scene across desert, forest, ocean, city and interior imagery. Ends in a filmed-with-Kino lockup. Exact settings, grading fidelity and complete playback unverified.
practical_implication: A manifesto and a visual-proof asset can be separate pieces with different jobs. Keep the treatment comparison on the same source; do not use two different images as a before/after.
rights: All reference media stayed in temporary local inspection files. No reference art or film is included as a Looksi campaign asset.
